name: Slayer Fleet-Foot
body:
Some hunters and slayers do not have the time to take time and study their targets and instead rely on speed and agility to win the day. These slayers are the fleet- foot slayers.

Skirmish (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, the fleet-foot gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, Reflex Saves and CMD as long as they move at least 10 ft on their turn.

This bonus lasts until the start of their next turn and increases by an additional +1 at 4th level and every 4 class levels thereafter to a maximum of +6 at 20th level.

At 3rd level, once per day as a swift action after moving 10 ft on their turn, they treat any attacks made before the beginning of their next turn as satisfying the conditions for sneak attack. They gain an additional use of this sneak attack at 5th, 10th, and 15th levels.

This ability replaces studied target and all the extra studied targets.

Fleet-Foot Master (Ex)

At 20th level, they can use their skirmish ability an unlimited number of times per day. Additionally, they gain two additional uses of slayer’s advance.

This ability replaces master slayer.
